x: Then there followed all in quick succession the remaining five of the “ A ” Team, Don Heath, Hugh McGreechan, “Sir” Harry Shields, Joe Wilson and Dick Frazer.
We were pleased to see Dick Frazer among the prize winners after his gallant effort in the “ Brighton ” and H. Jeffery’ who also performed so well in that race.

The “B” team, of which we are equally proud, consisted of Joe Wilson, Dick Frazer, Fred Rolfe, Syd Spencer and Frank Jarvis, but, unfortunately, the latter blistered rather badly and was forced to retire.
Our other " A " Team men, Dick Frazer, Fred Rolfe and Joe Wilson, all finished in the thirties. A most surprising race was walked by John Downs, a member who we have seen but little of.
